meta.method: Depth pass on bag, watch and jewelry brands already present in research-clothing-bagswatches.json and research-clothing-accessories.json. Confirmed:true items were retrieved directly via WebFetch (Timex, Swatch, Tissot, Apple, Rotary, Sekonda, Seiko SSK003/SRPK18, Citizen AO9020-84E/JW0137-51E, Tous MX). All other items are drawn from WebSearch result snippets that explicitly quote prices from the named brand or retailer's own domain (coach.com, michaelkors.com, katespade.com, fossil.com, longchamp.com, johnlewis.com, herschel.com, tumi.com, shop.samsonite.com, guess.com, guesswatches.com, macys.com, gshock.casio.com, liverpool.com.mx, seikousa.com, swarovski.com, selfridges.com, kendrascott.com, harrods.com, us.missoma.com, mejuri.com, thomassabo.com, us/ie/mx.pandora.net); these are marked confirmed:false with the search source noted. No product was invented and no price was converted between currencies or guessed. Items already present in research-clothing-bagswatches.json or research-clothing-accessories.json were excluded.
corrections: 2026-10-05, on review: Garmin's watches dropped (3), list prices quoted secondhand by deal sites.
